entities.summary: Shorty, a notable figure in the history of Trinidad and Tobago, associated with Carnival, Calypso, and the Steelpan Revolution (1970–1999). Preceded by Soca, Carnival, and Global Cultural Reach and Kitchener. Their legacy influenced Black Power demonstrations and army mutiny — February–April 1970.
